ui.items.general.label: General
ui.items.general.items.safetywarning.tex: Safety notice: Start with Dry Run enabled. Normal shopping items are still sorted only by redistributing their visible texts. If market headings are enabled, ShoppingRoute creates and deletes only its own ═════ MARKET ═════ heading entries through Alexa2.
ui.items.general.items.alexainstance.hel: Only installed and enabled Alexa2 instances are offered. After changing the instance, save once so the list dropdowns can be refreshed from that instance.
ui.items.general.items.dryrun.label: Dry run (do not write to Alexa)
ui.items.general.items.logsortsummary.la: Show completion message after a sorting run in the log
ui.items.general.items.prioritymarket.he: Used when an item has no explicit market and no product-specific default market.
ui.items.general.items.temporarymarkethe: The market for the current shopping trip temporarily overrides list and global default markets. Select “— No market —” in the dropdown to return to the normal defaults.
ui.items.general.items.apiwarning.text: Only change these settings if you know what you are doing.
ui.items.general.items.apihelp.text: API Safe Mode limits direct Alexa write frequency to avoid unnecessary request bursts. ShoppingRoute does not poll Amazon.
ui.items.general.items.apisafemode.label: Enable API Safe Mode
ui.items.liststab.label: Lists
ui.items.liststab.items.listshelp.text: ShoppingRoute reads the available lists from the selected Alexa2 instance. After changing the Alexa2 instance, save once and reopen this page. Each list may have its own default market. The Alexa app must use 'Oldest to newest' for every managed list.
ui.items.liststab.items.lists.label: Managed Alexa lists
ui.items.marketstab.label: Markets
ui.items.productgroupstab.label: Product groups
ui.items.routestab.label: Walking routes
ui.items.routestab.items.routeshelp.text: Choose a market above, then move its product groups with ↑/↓ into the actual walking order. The complete route list remains stored internally and is updated automatically.
ui.items.productstab.label: Products
Click Product, Product group or Default market headers to sort. The catalogue itself is stored alphabetically, so equal groups/markets stay alphabetic. Available markets are comma-separated; the default market is the preferred exception to global/list priorities.
ui.items.reviewtab.label: Review
ui.items.reviewtab.items.reviewhelp.text: Unknown products appear here in review mode. Correct the product, product group, default market, available markets or aliases. Accept immediately moves the product into the catalogue and removes its review row in the draft. Then save normally; discarding undoes unsaved changes.
ui.items.transfertab.label: Backup / Sharing
ui.items.transfertab.items.backuphelp.te: Backups and market profiles are downloaded directly as JSON files or restored from a file. The JSON content does not need to be displayed or edited. After importing, save the configuration.
ui.items.general.items.marketheaders.hel: Adds entries such as ═════ ALDI ═════. A heading remains active while at least one real item for that market is open and is deleted completely when the market is no longer needed.
ui.items.general.items.minitemspermarket: 1 disables consolidation. Below the threshold, only articles with configured alternative available markets may be moved. Explicit phrases such as “from LIDL” or “at ALDI” are never moved.
ui.items.shoppinglisttab.label: Shopping list
